args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

When two statements are uploaded concurrently or close together, their jobs query existing transactions in range independently before either has committed its transactions. As a result, neither job sees the overlapping days inserted by the other, causing duplicates to slip through. We should ensure concurrent or overlapping uploads are properly deduplicated across pending/recent transactions or serialized.
args.title: Prevent duplicate insertions from concurrent overlapping statement uploads

file: src/ingest/worker.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When statements are uploaded together or concurrently, their processing jobs query the database for existing transactions in range independently before any of them have finished inserting, missing the overlapping days.
